objectives.text: Turn copper and lithium into the base of the economy and into leverage with both Washington and Beijing. Kast says Chile must give legal certainty and guarantees to large foreign investors, and that the bigger risk is low investment; he refuses to choose between the United States and China, calling trade with China very important and the US relationship historic and strategic. A regional minerals declaration with Argentina, Bolivia and Peru (Santiago, 28 August 2026) aims at copper and lithium together.

objectives.text: Close the northern border to irregular migration and carry out expulsions, the first government agenda of Kast. Border entries fell by 93.5% in January-August 2026 against the same months of 2025 (286 against 4,393, government figures as reported), and expulsion flights began in April 2026. The Border Shield plan promises a 3,000-strong force, walls, towers, drones and trenches.

grand_strategy.reading: Chile under Kast is trying to turn its copper and lithium into a position it can hold between the United States and China, while it tightens the northern border as the proof that its security policy works. The balancing line is real but thin: the US coalition is joined with explicit limits, China is needed as a buyer, and the regional minerals pact with Argentina, Bolivia and Peru is the first sign that the neighbours can be partners on resources as well as on migration. The weak point is the border itself, whose results depend on the controls of Peru and Bolivia and on a Congress that has already rejected part of the plan.

stances.note: Kast calls the US relationship historic and strategic but says Chile is not allied with either superpower. Chile joined the Shield of the Americas, a US-promoted security coalition, and refused foreign troops on its soil and operations abroad. Warming is our reading of the coalition membership against the 2026 posture (C); the grade partner is our reading, since no source uses it and Kast's own word is that Chile is not aligned. Bond none is our reading. Gap: the 2025 copper tariff and its effect are not verified in this pass.

stances.note: Kast's first official trip abroad was to Milei in Argentina (April 2026), a move both governments see as offsetting Lula's regional influence; the press calls it a conservative axis.
